name: hero-block
title: Hero block
description: The top of a page as the slides, posts and ads set it: a Funnel Display headline, a line of DM Sans and one White button on Black, with the light flowing in and the media (a search bar, a row of creatives) under the copy.
use_for: The first thing on a website page. Left with a search bar on a band of the light (the ad), centered under the light field (the offer post), or right-aligned over creatives on the curved strip (the deck cover).
never: A headline that does not end with a period, or in title case
The light boxed in the middle of the copy, recolored or moving
source: Figma page 8: Ad, The only creative search engine (headline at 64,168, the line at 312, the search bar on a Light band); Post, Offer and Ad, Creator plan offer (centered under the Light field); Pitch deck cover, Curved strip (headline at the top right, creatives over the curved strip)
body:
`light` sets where the light flows: `field` from the top edge, `corner` from the bottom right, `band` across the media
and `strip` above it, or `none`. `texture` adds the ASCII texture behind it. The headline takes inline nodes in React
(the deck's creatives between the words) and a `headline` slot in the web component.

examples.name: Search
examples.label: Left, with the search bar on a band
examples.content:
<!-- The ad's top: the headline and the line, the search bar across a band of the light. -->
<spyglass-hero-block headline="The only creative search engine." body="AI search across millions of creatives. Ask a question and get instant, structured results." light="band" seed="2" texture>
  <spyglass-button slot="actions" href="#pricing">Get 50% off</spyglass-button>
  <spyglass-search-bar placeholder="Show me UGC ads for skincare brands using before/after hooks" aria-label="Search creatives"></spyglass-search-bar>
</spyglass-hero-block>

examples.name: Strip
examples.label: Right, over the curved strip
examples.content:
<!-- The third deck cover: the headline at the top right, creatives over the curved strip. -->
<spyglass-hero-block headline="The only creative search engine." placement="right" light="strip" seed="0" texture>
  <spyglass-creative-row class="mt-32 max-sm:mt-16" items='[{"brand":"Acme Studio","tone":2},{"brand":"Acme Fit","tone":3},{"brand":"Acme Drinks","tone":4},{"brand":"Acme Skin","tone":1},{"brand":"Acme Studio","tone":3},{"brand":"Acme Drinks","tone":2},{"brand":"Acme Fit","tone":4}]'></spyglass-creative-row>
</spyglass-hero-block>
